concepts.title: Horizontal square reference
concepts.instruction: Draw the true square in plan and its edge elevation on XY, with connecting projectors.

concepts.title: View axes
concepts.instruction: Draw a baseline and both receding axes at 30° to it from A.

concepts.title: True-size rhombus
concepts.instruction: Set off 40 mm to B and D, then draw BC and DC parallel to the opposite sides.

concepts.title: Reduced scale
concepts.instruction: Construct the PDF scale and obtain the reduced 40 mm length.

concepts.title: Projected rhombus
concepts.instruction: Repeat the two axes and four sides with iso 40.

concepts.title: Dimension the result
concepts.instruction: Retain the axis-angle arcs and both sets of labels and length dimensions.
